text:
Alex Kim: heads up — ACME APAC ramp changed, customer's asking to double Q4 throughput. want to sync on private pod right-sizing.
Mira Patel: thanks. current baseline we sized for 4x A100-80GB (shared across 2 pods) — what's their new qps / peak concurrency?
Alex Kim: projection from CE: 1200 concurrent users -> ~450 infer/sec at 1.2 reqs/user during peaks; p50 target 110ms p50 token latency. they run mix of chat + long-context rerank.
Sam Ortega: rough calc: 4x80GB gave ~180 rps for our v1 model at 512 context. if they need 450rps at same perf, that's ~2.5x -> recommend 10 GPUs with 1.5x headroom => 15 GPUs.
Jia Chen: 15 seems high. we can reduce with quantization and batching tweaks; try 8x A100 + aggressive KV cache + shorter context for 80% of traffic -> maybe 10 GPUs.
Ryan O'Neal: procurement lead time is 10–12 weeks for new hardware in APAC. also rack space/PSU constraints for customer DC? need to confirm.
Mira Patel: good point. also network: cross-region fallback to us-west adds egress costs and latency spike. if we offload 20% to hosted fallback we can buy fewer GPUs.
Alex Kim: cost check — customer prefers capex but will accept monthly committed capacity. We should give two options: on-prem 10x A100s + 20% hosted fallback OR full 15x on-prem for standalone.
Sam Ortega: quick calc snippet I used:
```
# rough GPU-hour need per day
rps=450
tokens_per_req=60
tokens_per_gpu_per_sec=12000  # approximated
gpu_needed=$(echo "scale=2; ($rps*$tokens_per_req)/($tokens_per_gpu_per_sec*3600)" | bc)
```
Sam Ortega: (note: that formula underestimates because of context and KV cache misses). adjust by factor 2 for safety.
Jia Chen: also include N+1 for maintenance. so requested 10 -> provision 11. For 15 -> provision 16.
Ryan O'Neal: what about bursting on cloud spot pools for holiday peaks? APAC spot availability unstable. can we do cross-customer burst on Dedicated cluster instead?
Mira Patel: Dedicated burst is an option; we'd need SLA waiver and a capacity pool. Billing complexity for customer because of data isolation in private deployments.
Alex Kim: propose we prepare three deliverables for CE by EOD:
- Option A: Conservative on-prem (16 GPUs A100) with N+1, no hosted fallback, cost + procurement timeline
- Option B: Hybrid (11 GPUs + hosted fallback 20% traffic) faster to ship, lower capex
- Option C: Optimized (10 GPUs + model quant + routing) - requires acceptance of quality delta and more ops tuning
Sam Ortega: i'll run perf sims on toy cluster tonight and post numbers.
Jia Chen: i'll draft a network checklist (bandwidth, peerings, egress caps, MTU, BGP config) — past customers hit 750Mbps per pod under KV miss storms.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: FYI: no incidents in APAC infra this week. :white_check_mark:
Alex Kim: thanks team. ping me once sims + network checklist posted. want to present to CE tomorrow morning.
Mira Patel: noted. i'll also include a cost delta table and procurement ETA.
Sam Ortega: posted perf sim results: 8 GPUs -> 210 rps, 12 GPUs -> 330 rps, extrapolating gives 450rps ~16 GPUs (confirming earlier). attaching small csv in convo.
Alex Kim: great, will fold into options. tagging @CE for visibility when we send.
